India.heading: Your Indian qualification
India.prepare: Write down both the degree-awarding university and the teaching college, if different. Use the institution and qualification on your degree when opening the WES document instructions.
India.delivery: Your physiotherapy school issues the internship completion certificate; a hospital certificate is not the substitute CAPR requests.
India.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Philippines.heading: Your Philippine qualification
Philippines.prepare: Keep three records distinct: your academic degree/transcript, your school-issued internship completion certificate, and any professional registration record. They establish different facts.
Philippines.delivery: Ask the physiotherapy school for the internship certificate to upload to CAPR. Arrange degree/transcript delivery through the WES requirements for your school.
Philippines.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Pakistan.heading: Your Pakistani qualification
Pakistan.prepare: Start with the university and exact credential printed on your degree. Use that institution’s WES document instructions before ordering official academic delivery.
Pakistan.delivery: Ask your physiotherapy school for the internship completion certificate. Keep the school-issued record rather than substituting a hospital employment certificate.
Pakistan.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Egypt.heading: Your Egyptian qualification
Egypt.prepare: Prepare the degree and transcript using WES’s instructions for your university. Keep the original-language records; check the receiving organization’s translation instructions before paying a translator.
Egypt.delivery: Request the clinical internship completion certificate from your physiotherapy school. CAPR does not accept a hospital-issued certificate in its place.
Egypt.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Nigeria.heading: Your Nigerian qualification
Nigeria.prepare: Use the university and original qualification on your degree to select WES requirements. Do not describe a professional registration document as an academic transcript.
Nigeria.delivery: Prepare academic documents for the WES report. If an assessor or regulator requests professional standing, request that separately from the issuing authority.
Nigeria.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Bangladesh.heading: Your Bangladeshi qualification
Bangladesh.prepare: Record the teaching institution and awarding university separately if your programme was delivered through an affiliated institution. Check the exact credential in WES’s instructions.
Bangladesh.delivery: If WES does not evaluate your institution, ask CAPR for next steps before paying for an unsuitable report.
Bangladesh.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Ghana.heading: Your Ghanaian qualification
Ghana.prepare: Keep the qualification, university transcript and any professional standing record separate. Registration or employment in another country does not change the country of your entry-to-practice education.
Ghana.delivery: Request the academic records through the WES instructions for your qualification. Obtain professional standing only using the recipient’s requirements.
Ghana.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Nepal.heading: Your Nepalese qualification
Nepal.prepare: Record both the institution that taught your programme and the university that awarded your qualification. Resolve differences in names before arranging document delivery.
Nepal.delivery: Use WES requirements for the awarding institution and credential, rather than choosing a school solely because its name is similar.
Nepal.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

United Arab Emirates.heading: Your UAE qualification
United Arab Emirates.prepare: This page is for entry-to-practice physiotherapy education completed in the UAE. If you only live or work in the UAE, choose the country where you trained.
United Arab Emirates.delivery: For a branch-campus or cross-border qualification, ask the assessor how to identify the awarding institution and study location before paying.
United Arab Emirates.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Hong Kong.heading: Your Hong Kong qualification
Hong Kong.prepare: The pre-approved route still requires the qualifying education and registration conditions; being educated in Hong Kong does not itself waive CAPR’s language test.
Hong Kong.delivery: For the pre-approved route, the Physiotherapists Board sends the Certificate of Standing directly to CAPR. Keep this separate from your school transcript.
Hong Kong.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

South Africa.heading: Your South African qualification
South Africa.prepare: A qualifying South African degree and unrestricted registration may support the pre-approved route. CAPR’s separate education-country language exemption does not list South Africa.
South Africa.delivery: Prepare registration details for CAPR’s verification and plan accepted language evidence unless another exemption applies.
South Africa.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

France.heading: Your French qualification
France.prepare: France is not on the pre-approved credential pathway list. Education completed in France can meet CAPR’s classroom-and-clinical education language exemption conditions.
France.delivery: Original French documents do not need an English translation merely because they are in French. Follow WES and CAPR requirements for the actual document language. Quebec uses OPPQ’s separate process.
France.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Australia.heading: Your Australian qualification
Australia.prepare: Ask your university which CAPR-approved academic delivery channel it uses. My eQuals is listed for Australian academic records under the pre-approved route.
Australia.delivery: If the shared document has a PIN, enter it in the Digital Documents section of your CAPR profile so CAPR can open it.
Australia.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

Ireland.heading: Your Irish qualification
Ireland.prepare: This entry is for the Republic of Ireland. Education in Northern Ireland belongs under United Kingdom. Use where you completed your entry-to-practice training, not your citizenship.
Ireland.delivery: Ask your school to use the CAPR Institution Portal or another channel CAPR lists for the pre-approved route. Include your CAPR Client ID.
Ireland.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

New Zealand.heading: Your New Zealand qualification
New Zealand.prepare: Ask your university about academic record delivery through My eQuals, the channel listed by CAPR for New Zealand under the pre-approved route.
New Zealand.delivery: Provide any document access PIN in your CAPR profile. Keep the sharing confirmation and your Client ID with the request.
New Zealand.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

United Kingdom.heading: Your UK qualification
United Kingdom.prepare: CAPR lists Gradintelligence and university-specific delivery arrangements. Its document page identifies Verify for Birmingham and Brunel, and direct transcript delivery for University College London.
United Kingdom.delivery: Use the channel listed for your actual university rather than assuming every UK school uses the same service.
United Kingdom.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.

United States.heading: Your US qualification
United States.prepare: This route uses an entry-to-practice qualification completed in the United States and the applicable unrestricted registration conditions. A US licence alone does not turn an overseas degree into a US qualification.
United States.delivery: CAPR lists Parchment and National Student Clearinghouse as academic delivery options. Ask your school which accepted channel it uses and include the CAPR Client ID.
United States.scope: Assessor-published rules and country-specific delivery notes. Institution-specific WES requirements are not inferred.
